name: two coupled Kerr parametric oscillators (two cat qubits or a two-spin annealer)

provenance.source: Goto, Sci. Rep. 6, 21686 (2016); Puri et al., Nat. Commun. 8, 15785 (2017)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

symmetric-write.obstruction: vanishing cubic term: the quadratic and cubic terms of the reduced drift vanish at the write point and the leading term is -6.25 s^5, so the canonical form is not the pitchfork and the swept-write test, whose noise is set by D_s |a3| / r, is not defined
symmetric-write.obstruction_short: vanishing cubic: leading term of order 5

threshold-write.class: S C R(degenerate cubic) W R(fold) K

phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of p in [0, 12] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: degenerate cubic: the quadratic and cubic terms vanish at the write point; the leading term along the critical direction is of order 5

law.start_of_sweep: the unwritten branch followed back from the write point
law.obstruction_in_nonlinear_stage: the law differs from the full dynamics by up to 0.437 (55.5 errors), and the written states at the end of the sweep do not retain the choice: 51 % of the trajectories change state during a hold of 56.6 time units at the end value of the control. The full dynamics gives the steady-state selection under the bias, an equilibrium write, not the linear-stage law; a retained write needs deeper states at the end of the sweep (a longer sweep, or less noise)

write_points.kind: subcritical pitchfork: symmetric, but the state jumps to a distant branch
